rationale: Battery discharges as early as possible (within power limits and pmin=12) to displace the most expensive diesel energy, subject to keeping SOC >= 2.5 MWh. Total battery discharge over the horizon is limited by usable SOC: 2.5 MWh internal * 0.9 discharge efficiency = 2.25 MWh delivered, i.e. 27 MW-intervals; on the 2 MW dispatch grid the maximum is 26 MW (8+10+8+0), leaving final SOC 2.593 MWh. Diesel = net_load - battery each interval, all within [12,55] MW. No PV curtailment or load shedding needed. Diesel energy = (12+17+29+35)*0.0833333 = 7.75 MWh, cost = 7.75*92 = 713.0 USD.
